name: Custom Classes
description: Adds custom character class names, custom subclasses (scoped per class), and class-level build choices (Cleric Divine Order, Fighter Weapon Mastery, Rogue Expertise, etc.) to the host's class system. Classes/subclasses appear in every class dropdown the host renders. Choices appear on the character form once the class is selected — picks rewrite skills, weapon/armor proficiencies, spells and traits and revert cleanly on class swap. Lists sync live across DM and players.
author: TableTop Forge
